paroecia, paroeciae f.

noun, first declension · Declension on Wiktionary

Greek παροικία, a sojourning; in the early Church it could mean a bishop’s whole district as well as a parish. The parish priest is parochus (M-O; Levi–Bini), the parish church templum paroeciāle (M-O, after Egger).

Other words

  • parochia, parochiae f. — parish (a later spelling)

    noun, first declension · also used · late Latin · Sid. Ep. 7.6 (Lewis & Short) · Declension on Wiktionary

    Lewis & Short call it a corruption; it is the form behind the modern words.

See also church, priest.
